text: Split radial source surfaces: moved errors, scalar opaque types, coordinates, kernels, atoms, and RadialBasisSpec into RadialCore.scala; moved radial index, mask-order, voxel selection, and decode selection types into RadialSelection.scala. RadialBasis.scala now starts at active voxels and is 600 lines instead of roughly 1115. Verification: sbt latentJVM/test latentJS/test passed 76 tests on each platform.
